name: Equip Compare Adv 1.6.0
body:
**Install:** download EquipCompareAdv-1.6.0.zip below or update through your launcher. Close the game fully and start it again (there is a new file).

- Green up arrow on items that are an upgrade for you, red down arrow on worse ones
- Works on bags (default, Bagshui, pfUI), vendors and the auction house
- Best in my bags: button in options or `/eca best`
- Switches: `/eca arrows`, `/eca worse`
- Also in this release: the Gear score line sits under ShaguScore (`/eca scorey`), shorter help
